name: wmebem-sim-rules-tests
description: database.rules.json tested in the Firebase Realtime Database emulator (CI job 'rules').

scripts.test: cp ../../database.rules.json database.rules.json && firebase emulators:exec --only database --project demo-emsim --config firebase.json "node --test rules.test.mjs"
scripts.e2e: cp ../../database.rules.json database.rules.json && firebase emulators:exec --only database --project demo-emsim --config firebase.e2e.json "cd .. && npx playwright test --config playwright.emulator.config.js"
